subject: On‑prem addendum: proposed evidence delivery schedule & rolling redlines
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@medtech-analytics.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medtech-analytics.com>, Elena Ruiz <eruiz@lawbridgepartners.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment addendum — evidence & escrow‑like ask

Marcus — thanks again for the demo. Legal reviewed the MSA/Order Form and has two asks before we can greenlight an on‑prem (customer‑managed infra) deployment:

1) Clarify license scope for model weights and inference runtime when deployed on our VPC — we need explicit outbound telemetry and data handling language.
2) Provide an evidence package schedule (SOC2 artifacts, retention docs, runtime logs access and a reasonable sample for a proof audit).

Counsel (Elena) suggested an escrow‑style commitment for a finite set of artifacts (not full source escrow) — essentially: deliver a signed evidence matrix and an attestation cadence plus a standby protocol if Redwood discontinues support. Can your team share a proposed timeline and redlines to the Private Deployment Addendum?

Appreciate a short plan we can review with procurement this week.

— Samantha
Senior Product Manager
MedTech Analytics

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@medtech-analytics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment addendum — evidence & escrow‑like ask

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Legal (Neha) and Security/Compliance (Olga) so we can produce a defensible proposal that aligns with Redwood policy. Quick responses:

- License scope: we can offer an "Inference Runtime License" limited to the model versions specified in the Order Form; weights remain Redwood IP but are licensed for customer‑managed runtime under the Private Deployment Addendum. Neha — we'll need a short redline to make that explicit.
- Evidence/attestation: we can commit to a timeboxed evidence package (SOC2 summary, retention policy, sample audit logs, and a signed attestation) and a 30/60/90 day delivery schedule for the initial package + quarterly attestations for 12 months.
- Escrow‑like standby protocol: we propose a "support wind‑down" clause (90‑day notice, transitional support plan, and an option to trigger a third‑party assisted extraction of telemetry/signed logs). This is narrower than full source escrow and should address procurement concerns.

I'll attach a first pass redline and an evidence matrix for your review. Can you confirm whether your procurement needs the attestation notarized or if a Redwood C‑suite signoff is sufficient?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@medtech-analytics.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment addendum — evidence & escrow‑like ask

Marcus / Olga — attaching a targeted redline to the Private Deployment Addendum. Key notes in the doc:

- License: explicit limited license language for deployed binaries and model checkpoints; no transfer of IP.
- Audit requests: defined scope (logs, configuration snapshots, access records) and frequency (initial + quarterly). We capped the retrospective window to 12 months to limit broad data exposures.
- Standby protocol: defined as "operational continuity assistance" — incremental, priced support and a defined runbook; we avoid source/code escrow but will provide artifact bundles and a third‑party facilitator option if Redwood discontinues support.

I also added a sample schedule in the evidence matrix: initial delivery within 30 business days after Order Form signature, then quarterly attestations. Please review the attached redline (Redwood_PrivateDeployment_Addendum_v2_redline.docx) and the evidence matrix.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@lawbridgepartners.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@medtech-analytics.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@medtech-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment addendum — evidence & escrow‑like ask

Neha / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few points from procurement/counsel on our side:

- The 30 business day initial delivery is reasonable. Procurement will want the initial deliverables enumerated (SOC2 summary, sample logs, retention policy, test runbook).
- For the standby protocol, they prefer a named third‑party facilitator rather than a generic option — can Redwood propose a vetted partner or accept a neutral escrow agent?
- Also: can Redwood include a limited indemnity tied to evidence accuracy for the 12‑month attestation period?

If you can provide a revised redline addressing these three items, we can aim to finalize the addendum and push the Order Form to DocuSign.

— Elena (on behalf of MedTech Analytics legal)

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@medtech-analytics.com>, Elena Ruiz <eruiz@lawbridgepartners.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@medtech-analytics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment addendum — evidence & escrow‑like ask

Team — thanks, all. Quick update and next steps: 

1) Neha updated the redline to enumerate the initial deliverables (see attached evidence_matrix_MT_20261125.xlsx).
2) On third‑party facilitator: Redwood has two vetted partners we can offer (named in the redline appendix); we can also accept a neutral escrow agent if MedTech prefers — we'll add language to permit either path.
3) Indemnity: legal will provide a limited accuracy indemnity scoped to the attestations; details are in the redline.

Action items:
- Marcus: share the revised addendum and Order Form DocuSign link for signature today. (DocuSign link attached: OrderForm_MT-1127_DocuSign_Link.pdf)
- Samantha / Elena: confirm if MedTech needs notarization on attestations or whether a Redwood C‑suite signoff suffices.
- Olga: security to prepare the sample log export (anonymized) and the runbook we referenced; aim for delivery with the initial package (within 30 business days).

If procurement is fine with these points, we can proceed to signature and schedule the kick‑off.

Best,
Marcus
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
